items.title: Pay disputed collection claim
items.quote: Überweisen Sie den Betrag bis zum 22.10.2025 auf das Konto IBAN BG30 BUIN 9561 1000 4728 10, Empfänger: V. Dimitrova.
items.explanation: The letter states an explicit calendar date ('bis zum 22.10.2025') rather than a period to be counted. 22.10.2025 is a Wednesday, not a weekend day or a public holiday in NRW, so no §193 BGB shift applies. The due date is simply the date printed.

warnings: The payment is demanded to a Bulgarian IBAN (BG30 BUIN...) payable to a private individual (V. Dimitrova), not a German business account – this is a strong scam/fraud indicator for a German debt‑collection claim and should be verified before any payment is made.

The letter threatens immediate Schufa‑style credit‑bureau entry, wage garnishment ('Pfändung Ihres Gehalts') and bank‑account freezing ('Sperrung Ihres Bankkontos') without any mention of a court judgment or enforceable title; under German law such measures require a Vollstreckungstitel and cannot lawfully be imposed by a collection agency on its own – this is a pressure/intimidation tactic typical of scam dunning letters.

The one-month Widerspruch period then runs from the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB analog) and, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day, i.e. 13.01.2026. 13.01.2026 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, so no further shift applies. The Widerspruch must reach the Landkreis in writing (or be declared for the record) by this date.

warnings: The exact postal dispatch date is not stated in the letter; the deadline computation assumes dispatch on the letter's own date (09.12.2025), which is the standard but unverified assumption — if actual posting was later, the deadline shifts accordingly.

The letter applies a four-day (rather than the federally standard three-day) postal notification fiction, citing § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V specifically; this Land-specific rule was taken at face value from the letter's own text.

items.explanation: Bescheid is dated Thursday, 28.10.2027, sent by regular mail. Under Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG, a written administrative act sent by post is deemed notified (bekanntgegeben) on the third day after posting; if that day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the next Werktag counts as the Bekanntgabe day. Assuming posting on 28.10.2027, the third day after is Sunday, 31.10.2027. The following day, Monday 01.11.2027, is Allerheiligen, a statutory public holiday in Bayern, so it is also not a Werktag. The next Werktag is Tuesday, 02.11.2027 — the deemed date of Bekanntgabe. Under §57 Abs. 2 VwGO i.V.m. §222 ZPO i.V.m. §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB, a one-month period triggered by an event excludes the day of the event itself and ends with the expiry of the day in the following month bearing the same number as the triggering day. One month after 02.11.2027 is 02.12.2027 (a Thursday), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or Bavarian public holiday, so the deadline stands unchanged.

warnings: The Klage deadline (2027-12-02) relies on the assumption that the Bescheid was actually posted on its issue date (28.10.2027) and the statutory 3-day postal-delivery fiction under Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG; if the actual mailing or receipt date differed, double-check the real delivery date to confirm the deadline.

The letter explicitly warns that filing a legal remedy by simple e-mail has no legal effect ('Die Einlegung eines Rechtsbehelfs per einfacher E-Mail ist nicht zugelassen und entfaltet keine rechtlichen Wirkungen.') — any objection must be filed with the court in proper written/electronic form, not by ordinary email.
The €1,500 Zwangsgeld is only a contingent liability that arises if the removal deadline (05.01.2028) is missed; it is not a current invoice to be paid now.

items.quote: auf Ihren Antrag vom 18.11.2024 bewilligen wir Ihnen Arbeitslosengeld ab dem 01.01.2025 für 360 Kalendertage.
items.explanation: Start date is stated explicitly in the letter as 01.01.2025; it is a calendar date, used as written.

items.title: Report any change in circumstances immediately (e.g. new job, illness)
items.quote: Bitte melden Sie uns jede Änderung sofort, zum Beispiel eine Arbeitsaufnahme oder eine Erkrankung.
items.explanation: This is an ongoing reporting duty ('sofort' = immediately) without any specific calendar date or period attached, so no fixed due date can be computed; it applies continuously for as long as benefits are received.

items.title: File Widerspruch against the Arbeitslosengeld decision
items.quote: Den Widerspruch gegen diese Entscheidung richten Sie innerhalb eines Monats ab ihrer Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift an die Agentur für Arbeit Beispielkirchen, Agenturplatz 3, 45879 Beispielkirchen.
items.explanation: The letter is dated Thu 05.12.2024; as an authority letter sent by ordinary post, under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 3rd day after posting, i.e. Sun 08.12.2024 (this day does not shift for social-law letters even though it is a Sunday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) starts the next day, 09.12.2024, and ends under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB one month later on Wed 08.01.2025. That day is a normal working day in NW, so no further shift applies.

spec.text: Den Widerspruch gegen diese Entscheidung richten Sie innerhalb eines Monats ab ihrer Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift an die Agentur für Arbeit Beispielkirchen
